content.text:
* Folded NMOS input stage and NMOS output gain stage.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL NT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XINN D1 VINN NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=2
XINP D2 VINP NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=2
* PMOS mirror reference and folding current sources.
XBP PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPR PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=50 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPS1 D1 PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPS2 D2 PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
RF1 IBIAS PC 10meg
RF2 PC VSS 10meg
CF PC VSS 1p
XFC1 NM PC D1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XFC2 N2 PC D2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* Current-mirror conversion to a single-ended first-stage output.
XNM1 NM NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNM2 N2 NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=4 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS second stage improves positive-supply rejection.
XNO VOUT N2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=4 nf=1 m=2
XPO VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=2
CPB PB VDD 2p
RC N2 NC 4000
CC NC VOUT 12p
.ends DUT
